question: Which country has the longest written constitution?
solution:
The correct answer is** __ India.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** India's constitution is the longest in the world, with 448 articles and 12 schedules.**
 
• The constitution was adopted on **January 26, 1950, **and has since undergone several amendments.
 
• The constitution outlines the fundamental rights and duties of Indian citizens, as well as the structure and functions of the government.
 
• The constitution is considered a living document, as it has been amended over 100 times to reflect changing social, political, and economic conditions in India.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** Option 2****: Indonesia's constitution has 37 chapters and 194 articles. It was adopted in 1945 and has been amended several times since then.**
 
• **Option 3****: Canada's constitution is not a single document, but rather a collection of laws, conventions, and court decisions. It includes the Constitution Act of 1867, the Canadian Charter of Rights and Freedoms, and other statutes and regulations.**
 
• **Option 4**: The United States of America's constitution has 7 articles and 27 amendments. It was adopted in 1787 and has since been amended several times. The Bill of Rights, which outlines individual rights and freedoms, is the first of 10 amendments to the Constitution.
